a11yMsg_missing-label: {{element}} has nothing for {{reader}} to read out.
a11yMsg_duplicate-label: {{count}} controls are announced as “{{label}}”: people cannot tell them apart by ear.
a11yMsg_input-without-label: {{element}} gives no clue what to enter.
a11yMsg_redundant-role: “{{label}}” already gets its role announced: drop words like “button” or “image”.
a11yMsg_not-accessible: {{element}} has isAccessibilityElement = false, VoiceOver skips it.
a11yMsg_non-text-contrast: {{element}}: the graphic stands out {{ratio}} : 1 from the background, needs {{required}} : 1.
a11yMsg_target-spacing: {{element}} is small and less than {{gap}} {{unit}} from {{neighbour}}: easy to tap the wrong one.
a11yMsg_nested-clickable: {{element}} contains {{count}} other control(s): TalkBack may read them as one and activate the wrong one.
a11yMsg_hidden-focusable: {{element}} is not visible, but VoiceOver still stops on it.
a11yMsg_non-descriptive-label_code: “{{label}}” is a resource or identifier name, not words a person understands.
a11yMsg_non-descriptive-label_long: {{element}} is announced with {{length}} characters: keep it short.
a11yMsg_hint-only-input: {{element}} is named by the hint “{{hint}}”, which disappears once text is entered.
a11yMsg_state-missing: {{element}} looks like a toggle but does not tell {{reader}} whether it is on or off.
a11yMsg_text-clipping: {{element}} ends with an ellipsis: part of the text is lost.
a11yMsg_reading-order: {{reader}} reaches {{element}} after {{previous}}, which is below it on screen.
a11yMsg_testability: {{element}} has no {{attribute}}: tests have to find it by text or position.
a11yFix_missing-label: Set contentDescription (Android) or accessibilityLabel (iOS) to the action, e.g. “Close”.
a11yFix_touch-target: Grow the tappable area with padding or minHeight/minWidth; the icon itself can stay small.
a11yFix_duplicate-label: Make each label say what it acts on: “Delete card *1234” instead of “Delete”.
a11yFix_low-contrast: Darken the text or lighten the background until the ratio reaches the requirement.
a11yFix_input-without-label: Give the field a visible label linked to it (labelFor / accessibilityLabel).
a11yFix_redundant-role: Remove “button”, “icon”, “image” from the label: the platform announces the role.
a11yFix_not-accessible: Set isAccessibilityElement = true on the control or its container.
a11yFix_non-text-contrast: Use a darker icon or outline, at least 3 : 1 against what is behind it.
a11yFix_target-spacing: Enlarge the targets or add space between them.
a11yFix_nested-clickable: Make either the row or the inner control clickable, or give the inner one a custom action.
a11yFix_hidden-focusable: Hide the element from accessibility while it is invisible (accessibilityElementsHidden / isAccessibilityElement = false).
a11yFix_non-descriptive-label: Write the label as a person would say it: “Share”, not “shareButton”.
a11yFix_hint-only-input: Add a persistent label above the field and keep the hint for an example value.
a11yFix_state-missing: Use a real Switch/CheckBox or expose the state (stateDescription / accessibilityValue).
a11yFix_text-clipping: Let the text wrap to more lines, or shorten it; check again with the largest font.
a11yFix_reading-order: Order the views in the layout as they appear, or set accessibilityTraversalBefore/After.
